name: Interactive Voice & Waveform Studio
summary: Real-time HTML5 Canvas audio frequency visualizer, multi-voice speech synthesizer, and downloadable WAV clip history table.
guide: Enter your text, choose a custom filename prefix, and click Synthesize to watch live audio waves and download .wav clips.

name: Slash Prompt & Architecture Engine
summary: Interactive developer slash command workstation (/debug, /refactor, /systemdesign, /security, /blueprint) for instant engineering blueprints.
guide: Select any slash command pill, enter your topic or code snippet, and execute to generate structured technical diagnostics.

name: AI Website Generator
summary: Automated web layout and responsive HTML/CSS boilerplate generator powered by structured prompt templates.
guide: Use the interactive generator to input a project title, theme style, and section list. The engine synthesizes a complete, single-file responsive HTML5 landing page ready for deployment.

name: ECC Cryptography Core
summary: Elliptic Curve Cryptography implementation for high-security key exchange, digital signatures, and mathematical encryption.
guide: Provides reference implementations for elliptic curve keypair generation. Pair with the ApiVault Auditor to verify key entropy and secret formatting.

name: Exa Studio ApiVault
summary: Centralized API key management, secret rotation auditing, and public endpoint directory.
guide: Open the interactive ApiVault Auditor, paste your API token, and evaluate its Shannon entropy score and character diversity without storing secrets on disk.

name: K2-FSA OmniVoice
summary: Next-generation multi-lingual neural voice synthesis and expressive speech generation engine.
guide: Requires GPU/PyTorch environment for full local model inference. Integrated conceptually with your Akhil Voice Studio pipeline.

name: OmniVoice Studio UI
summary: Web-based production workstation for managing voice cloning presets, pitch controls, and multi-track synthesis.
guide: Provides a graphical studio wrapper for neural TTS models with real-time audio waveform preview and custom file naming.

name: Handy Developer Utilities
summary: Lightweight, modular command-line and web developer scripts for rapid workflow automation.
guide: Use alongside the API Bridge to automate daily data formatting, JSON parsing, and text transformation tasks.

name: API Anything Bridge
summary: Turn static websites and unstructured web documents into clean, queryable JSON REST endpoints.
guide: Launch the live API Bridge tool, enter any public HTTP/HTTPS URL, and click Extract JSON to retrieve structured headings, metadata, and links.

name: TechGPTX Playlist Engine
summary: Automated playlist schema compiler, M3U8 generator, and audio metadata tag organizer.
guide: Open the Playlist Metadata Exporter, input your playlist name and comma-separated track list, and generate ready-to-use #EXTM3U playlists.

name: APK Static Structure Auditor
summary: Static archive analyzer for inspecting Android package headers, DEX file counts, and manifest presence safely.
guide: Upload any .apk file in the APK Static Inspector to review internal ZIP headers, classes.dex counts, and native library paths without executing binaries.

name: Reverse API Engineer
summary: Inspects network traffic HAR/cURL captures and synthesizes clean client SDK code.
guide: Copy a network request as cURL from your browser DevTools, paste it into the API Request Reverser, and generate production Python requests code.

name: API Schema Reverser
summary: Automated REST endpoint documentation and client wrapper generator from raw HTTP payloads.
guide: Use with the Request Reverser to map out HTTP verbs, custom authorization headers, and JSON payloads.

name: Maigret Footprint Analyzer
summary: Public username presence verifier for auditing digital footprints across open web registries.
guide: Open the Footprint OSINT Engine, enter a public handle, and query official developer registries (GitHub, Dev.to, GitLab) for public profile metadata.

name: Sherlock Handle Auditor
summary: Fast cross-platform username verification tool for open-source intelligence research.
guide: Integrated into the Footprint OSINT Engine to check handle availability and public repository counts in real time.

name: Recon-ng Domain Framework
summary: Modular web reconnaissance framework for DNS resolution and HTTP security header auditing.
guide: Launch the Domain Recon Suite, enter a domain name, and inspect its resolved IPv4 address alongside HSTS, CSP, and X-Frame-Options headers.

name: GodsEye Telemetry & Recon
summary: spatial and network telemetry dashboard for monitoring public infrastructure endpoints.
guide: Use the Domain Recon Suite to verify server banners and DNS health for your monitored domains.

name: MAGIX Music Quickstart
summary: Audio production templates, loop arrangement guides, and track mastering workflows.
guide: Use with the Playlist Metadata Exporter to organize mastered audio tracks into lossless FLAC cue sheets.

name: Awesome AI Agents Directory
summary: Curated architecture reference of autonomous LLM agents, multi-agent orchestrators, and tool-use frameworks.
guide: Reference directory for designing autonomous coding and research workflows.

name: GitHub AI Repository Ranker
summary: Automated indexing and popularity analytics for trending artificial intelligence repositories.
guide: Tracks star velocity, fork metrics, and developer adoption across open-source AI projects.

name: Defensive Security & Cyber Education
summary: Comprehensive educational study guides for network defense, cryptography, and security architecture.
guide: Provides defensive study materials for securing web servers, implementing strict CSP headers, and hardening cloud deployments.
